needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous footway along the left side to provide a safe pedestrian path away from the road.
Construct a continuous footway along the right side to provide a safe pedestrian path away from the road.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at this busy market junction to allow safe crossing when traffic is stopped.
Add a pedestrian refuge island at the centre of the crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when traffic is stopped.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to allow wheelchair access and improve pedestrian safety.
Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility for pedestrians and drivers, especially during evening hours.
